name: handboard two finger pocket
description: A hang with two fingers in a hangboard pocket. It builds strength for pocket holds and loads each finger hard, so increase it very gradually.
instructions: Start with a deep pocket and a lighter load than you use on four fingers.
Put two fingers, usually index and middle or middle and ring, into the pocket.
Take weight off with your feet or a pulley until the hang feels controlled.
Hang with straight arms and engaged shoulders for 5-10 seconds.
Stop at once if you feel a sharp pain in a finger.
Rest fully, then repeat or switch to the other finger pair.
